text:
incident-bot: PAGER: [sev-high] Model rollout 'variant-v3b' canary reporting tokenization + decode errors and elevated 5xx. Symptoms: garbled tokens, truncated output, downstream 502s. Paged to @ben_oncall. Runbook: /runbook model-rollout
alice_prod: Seeing spikes in generator errors; Sentry shows `invalid token id` on /v1/generate (prod-us-east). Affected customers: acme-corp (low), beta-user12 (high).
ben_oncall: On it — marking incident and pulling canary logs.
carla_sre: Looking at deployment metadata: artifact weight_tag=artifact:abc123 but tokenizer bundle indicates vocab_version=7 while stable expects 6. Suspect weight/tokenizer mismatch or config drift during promotion.
ben_oncall: Can we abort the rollout quickly? What's the feature flag name to stop routing?
carla_sre: Flag = `feature.rollout.variant_v3b`. Recommend immediate kill-switch flip for canary routing. Command: `rbacctl feature toggle --name=feature.rollout.variant_v3b --env=prod --value=false`
ben_oncall: Executing kill-switch now.
incident-bot: feature.rollout.variant_v3b set to `false` by ben_oncall at 7654322010 :white_check_mark:
alice_prod: :thumbsup: Traffic diverting back to stable-v3. Error rate dropping ~85% in canary cluster, but seeing some lingering failures from long-lived client sessions (cached tokenizer state).
dinesh_support: Logged tickets from impacted customers (acme-corp, beta-user12). CS triage assigned. Need ETA for rollback/complete mitigation.
emma_pm: Preparing customer comms draft. Please confirm ETA for full rollback and whether any data loss/corruption risk.
carla_sre: Recommend full rollback of canary artifact mapping to stable-weightset. Steps: (1) pin routing table to stable-v3, (2) rollback shard map. CLI: `deployctl rollback --service=model-proxy --from=variant-v3b --to=stable-v3 --reason='tokenizer-weight-mismatch'`
ben_oncall: Initiating rollback now. Will update when job starts/finishes.
incident-bot: deployctl rollback job started (job_id: jb-8721)
ben_oncall: Rollback completed on prod canary nodes. Verified model hash now matches stable `sha256:fedcba987654` and tokenizer config aligns with vocab_version=6.
carla_sre: Note: KV caches may contain stale KV entries for up to 120s and some proxies may still serve stale tokenizer mappings. Purging caches for affected proxies: `cachectl purge --selector=canary-proxy --prefix=model_variant_v3b`
ben_oncall: Purged caches. Post-purge metrics -> error rate back to baseline. Estimated customer impact window: ~00:10 - 00:32 UTC (~22 minutes).
dinesh_support: Collected impacted customer list + ticket numbers. Escalating enterprise accounts to CS leadership for outreach.
emma_pm: I'll send the post-incident comms and timeline after we confirm the final scope. Any follow-ups for release process?
carla_sre: Suggested action items: add preflight validation to ensure tokenizer vocab hash matches weightset before promotion; add canary-level auto-abort when tokenization errors > 5% for 2 consecutive minutes; update rollout runbook with explicit artifact+tokenizer pairing checks.
ben_oncall: Assigning follow-ups to @carla_sre (preflight + runbook) and @alice_prod (release checklist). I'll move this to oncall-followups.
incident-bot: Incident resolved — severity lowered and page closed. Thanks all for quick response :fade_in:
